aos-soulbound.power.binding.name: Binding

effect.summary: Entwines a group’s souls and lets them draw on one another’s essence.

aos-soulbound.power.binding.cost_or_limit: The link lasts until a member dies; joining is agonising and not everyone survives.
aos-soulbound.power.binding.go_wrong: The joining can kill those unable to endure it.
aos-soulbound.power.binding.where_from: Divine ritual of the ancient Soulbound order.
aos-soulbound.power.binding.combines: Connects members’ essence and serves as a conduit.
aos-soulbound.power.binding.blocked_reason: A persistent connection between souls and its termination at death need a soul-state mechanic.

aos-soulbound.power.soulfire.name: Soulfire

effect.summary: Spending it can guarantee a Test, reroll dice, restore Toughness or Mettle, or save a Mortally Wounded ally.

aos-soulbound.power.soulfire.cost_or_limit: Spend one shared Soulfire for an effect; the Binding must agree, and the pool is limited by eligible party members.
aos-soulbound.power.soulfire.go_wrong: Using it without the Binding’s consent adds Doom.
aos-soulbound.power.soulfire.who_may: Only members of a Binding may use it; Stormcast Eternals cannot.
aos-soulbound.power.soulfire.where_from: The Bonding of the Soulbound entwines their souls and lets them draw on one another’s strength.
aos-soulbound.power.soulfire.combines: It is tracked as a shared party resource; some exceptional artefacts or locations may enable unusual uses.
aos-soulbound.power.soulfire.mechanism: shared resource spent to produce effects
aos-soulbound.power.soulfire.blocked_reason: Its effects include several different outcomes and its use depends on consent and a shared party pool, beyond a single basic effect.

aos-soulbound.power.reforged.name: Reforged

effect.summary: A fallen Stormcast can return after being remade in Azyr.

aos-soulbound.power.reforged.cost_or_limit: The return may take hours or years.
aos-soulbound.power.reforged.go_wrong: Each reforging can worsen flaws and erode memories or personality.
aos-soulbound.power.reforged.mind: Can fracture memories and diminish humanity.
aos-soulbound.power.reforged.where_from: The Anvil of Apotheosis in Azyr.
aos-soulbound.power.reforged.combines: Sigmar’s will and the craft of the Six Smiths enable the return.
aos-soulbound.power.reforged.blocked_reason: This ability returns a dead character through soul recovery and bodily remaking.

aos-soulbound.power.species-bonus-adapta.name: SPECIES BONUS: ADAPTABLE

aos-soulbound.power.species-bonus-adapta.cost_or_limit: The Talent must meet its requirements.
aos-soulbound.power.species-bonus-adapta.combines: Cannot be used to acquire Spellcasting again if already possessed.

aos-soulbound.power.long-lived.name: Long-Lived

aos-soulbound.power.long-lived.cost_or_limit: XP must be spent on the same Skill.

aos-soulbound.power.too-stubborn-to-die.name: Too Stubborn to Die

effect.summary: Raises the character’s maximum Wounds by 2.

aos-soulbound.power.too-stubborn-to-die.cost_or_limit: Adds two spaces to the Wound Track.

aos-soulbound.power.spirit-song.name: Spirit-Song

effect.summary: A Sylvaneth adds a harmony to the song to send a nonverbal message to another Sylvaneth in the Realm of Life.

aos-soulbound.power.spirit-song.cost_or_limit: Requires a Soul Test; the GM sets difficulty by distance and circumstances, and no Skill applies.
aos-soulbound.power.spirit-song.go_wrong: Beyond Ghyran, Sylvaneth lose the full song and may suffer madness or melancholy.
aos-soulbound.power.spirit-song.mind: Being cut off is terrifying and may bring madness or melancholy.
aos-soulbound.power.spirit-song.who_may: Sylvaneth; communication is to another Sylvaneth in Ghyran.
aos-soulbound.power.spirit-song.combines: The song grows stronger when Sylvaneth gather.
aos-soulbound.power.spirit-song.blocked_reason: The stated message can be represented as information sent to a recipient.

aos-soulbound.power.natural-armour.name: Natural Armour

aos-soulbound.power.natural-armour.cost_or_limit: The character cannot wear armour; damaged natural Armour repairs after a Rest and may be reinforced.
aos-soulbound.power.natural-armour.go_wrong: Damage persists until a Rest, when it regrows.
aos-soulbound.power.natural-armour.combines: May be reinforced; see Ironbark Oil.
aos-soulbound.power.natural-armour.blocked_reason: A constant armour value and repair after rest fit the basic effect grammar.

aos-soulbound.power.spellcasting.name: Spellcasting

aos-soulbound.power.spellcasting.go_wrong: A spell can fail dangerously; excessive power can ruin its caster, and addiction or corruption may follow.
aos-soulbound.power.spellcasting.mind: Arcane use can become addictive and invite corrupting lore.
aos-soulbound.power.spellcasting.who_may: Spellcasters with the ability and training to cast
aos-soulbound.power.spellcasting.where_from: Magical energy of the Mortal Realms
aos-soulbound.power.spellcasting.combines: May be strengthened by shared casting and realm affinity.
aos-soulbound.power.spellcasting.blocked_reason: The passage gives broad spell effects rather than one defined effect for this general practice.

aos-soulbound.rule.binding-souls-remain-.blocked_reason: Maintaining an ongoing connection between absent members’ souls requires persistent soul-state.

aos-soulbound.rule.gods-can-transfer-a-s.name: Gods can transfer a soul between Bindings

effect.summary: In exceptional need, the gods may disentangle a soul and join it to another Binding.

aos-soulbound.rule.gods-can-transfer-a-s.cost_or_limit: Described as rare and done in times of need.
aos-soulbound.rule.gods-can-transfer-a-s.who_may: The gods can perform the transfer.
aos-soulbound.rule.gods-can-transfer-a-s.where_from: A soul already joined to a Binding.
aos-soulbound.rule.gods-can-transfer-a-s.blocked_reason: The effect changes a soul’s membership between persistent supernatural groups.

aos-soulbound.rule.a-soul-may-be-release.name: A soul may be released from a Binding

effect.summary: The gods are said possibly to free a soul from its Binding after an exceptional heroic or selfless act.

aos-soulbound.rule.a-soul-may-be-release.cost_or_limit: Only claimed for exceptional circumstances; the account may be a hopeful tale.
aos-soulbound.rule.a-soul-may-be-release.who_may: The gods may release the soul.
aos-soulbound.rule.a-soul-may-be-release.blocked_reason: The effect changes the persistent bonded status of a soul.

aos-soulbound.rule.doom-begins-at-1-and-.name: Doom begins at 1 and accrues during play

effect.summary: Doom starts at 1 and rises as the game proceeds, representing growing dread.

aos-soulbound.rule.doom-begins-at-1-and-.where_from: Growing danger in the Mortal Realms.
aos-soulbound.rule.doom-begins-at-1-and-.combines: Doom is used by the GM, while Soulbound characters use Soulfire.
aos-soulbound.rule.doom-begins-at-1-and-.blocked_reason: A rising tracked resource can be represented with the basic effect grammar.

aos-soulbound.rule.armour-reduces-damage.name: Armour reduces damage
aos-soulbound.rule.armour-reduces-damage.cost_or_limit: On a hit, reduce damage by the wearer’s Armour.
aos-soulbound.rule.armour-reduces-damage.go_wrong: Some weapons ignore or break Armour.
aos-soulbound.rule.armour-reduces-damage.combines: Talents and spells can increase or decrease Armour.
aos-soulbound.rule.armour-reduces-damage.blocked_reason: This is a direct numerical reduction to damage.

aos-soulbound.rule.toughness-and-wounds-.name: Toughness and Wounds are separate
aos-soulbound.rule.toughness-and-wounds-.cost_or_limit: A change to one does not necessarily change the other.
aos-soulbound.rule.toughness-and-wounds-.combines: Species, talents, and spells may affect either independently.
aos-soulbound.rule.toughness-and-wounds-.blocked_reason: The passage states a straightforward distinction between two ratings.

aos-soulbound.rule.threats-increase-doom.name: Threats increase Doom
aos-soulbound.rule.threats-increase-doom.cost_or_limit: When a Fear becomes a Threat, Doom rises by one.
aos-soulbound.rule.threats-increase-doom.go_wrong: Growing Doom may benefit some creatures.
aos-soulbound.rule.threats-increase-doom.combines: Some creatures gain bonuses based on Doom.
aos-soulbound.rule.threats-increase-doom.blocked_reason: A counter increasing by one is directly trackable.

aos-soulbound.rule.soulbound-immortality.name: Soulbound immortality for a Hag Priestess

effect.summary: A bound Hag Priestess becomes effectively immortal and no longer needs blood rites.

aos-soulbound.rule.soulbound-immortality.cost_or_limit: She is stripped of formal temple ties.
aos-soulbound.rule.soulbound-immortality.go_wrong: Her allegiances may change, and Morathi no longer trusts her.
aos-soulbound.rule.soulbound-immortality.combines: Soulbinding entwines souls with the Mortal Realms
aos-soulbound.rule.soulbound-immortality.blocked_reason: The described immortality and soul-linked change require mechanics beyond the basic effect grammar.

aos-soulbound.rule.soulbound-fyreslayers.name: Soulbound Fyreslayers cannot have children

effect.summary: Becoming Soulbound removes a Fyreslayer’s ability to reproduce.

aos-soulbound.rule.soulbound-fyreslayers.blocked_reason: The passage states a lasting biological restriction caused by soulbinding.

aos-soulbound.rule.one-in-a-hundred-idon.name: One in a hundred Idoneth are born with sustaining souls

effect.summary: Only a small fraction of Idoneth are born with souls strong enough to sustain life.

aos-soulbound.rule.one-in-a-hundred-idon.cost_or_limit: About one percent have such souls.
aos-soulbound.rule.one-in-a-hundred-idon.go_wrong: Others must replenish their life-force by taking souls.
aos-soulbound.rule.one-in-a-hundred-idon.blocked_reason: The rule depends on soul strength and life-force rather than basic effects.

aos-soulbound.rule.aether-gold-exposure-.name: Aether-gold exposure causes madness

effect.summary: Skin contact with aether-gold can cause maddening paranoia.

aos-soulbound.rule.aether-gold-exposure-.cost_or_limit: Even slight exposure can be dangerous.
aos-soulbound.rule.aether-gold-exposure-.blocked_reason: The exposure-triggered mental harm and immunity require a negative-effect rule.

aos-soulbound.rule.soulbound-and-stormca.name: Soulbound and Stormcasts cannot change into one another

effect.summary: The two kinds of champion undergo distinct, incompatible soul transformations.

aos-soulbound.rule.soulbound-and-stormca.blocked_reason: The restriction depends on persistent, incompatible soul states.

aos-soulbound.rule.stormcast-return-thro.name: Stormcast return through Reforging; fallen Soulbound do not

effect.summary: A dead Stormcast returns to the heavens to be remade, while a fallen Soulbound dies permanently.

aos-soulbound.rule.stormcast-return-thro.cost_or_limit: Stormcasts undergo repeated Reforging; Soulbound have no return after death.
aos-soulbound.rule.stormcast-return-thro.go_wrong: Repeated Reforging may cost Stormcasts their memories and identity.
aos-soulbound.rule.stormcast-return-thro.mind: Stormcasts risk losing themselves through Reforging.
aos-soulbound.rule.stormcast-return-thro.who_may: Stormcast Eternals, while Soulbound remain mortal
aos-soulbound.rule.stormcast-return-thro.combines: Stormcasts are remade with celestial lightning
aos-soulbound.rule.stormcast-return-thro.blocked_reason: Death, resurrection, remaking, and persistent memory loss require soul-state mechanics.

aos-soulbound.rule.geas.name: geas

effect.summary: A Knight-Questor’s quest governs them utterly.

aos-soulbound.rule.geas.combines: May direct them toward a new quest after the first is completed.
aos-soulbound.rule.geas.blocked_reason: The rule describes an overriding compulsion of the character.

aos-soulbound.rule.lamentiri-and-ancestr.name: lamentiri and ancestral memory

effect.summary: Sylvaneth lamentiri carry ancestral memories and are meant to return to groves for replanting after death; Soulbound deaths lose those memories.

aos-soulbound.rule.lamentiri-and-ancestr.cost_or_limit: Soulbound Sylvaneth cannot preserve their ancestral memories at death.
aos-soulbound.rule.lamentiri-and-ancestr.go_wrong: Memories and the deceased’s part of the Spirit Song are lost forever.
aos-soulbound.rule.lamentiri-and-ancestr.mind: Memory is carried through generations in lamentiri.
aos-soulbound.rule.lamentiri-and-ancestr.combines: Branchwyches collect and replant fallen lamentiri.
aos-soulbound.rule.lamentiri-and-ancestr.blocked_reason: The rule defines how memories persist or vanish through death and rebirth.

aos-soulbound.rule.untrained-skill-test.name: Untrained Skill Test

effect.summary: An untrained character uses their base Attribute as the dice pool for a Skill Test.

aos-soulbound.rule.untrained-skill-test.cost_or_limit: A GM may disallow untrained attempts.
aos-soulbound.rule.untrained-skill-test.combines: Can be modified by Training or Focus.
aos-soulbound.rule.untrained-skill-test.blocked_reason: This is a standard test procedure.

aos-soulbound.rule.training.name: Training

effect.summary: Each Training level adds one die to Skill Tests, up to three levels.

aos-soulbound.rule.training.cost_or_limit: Maximum Training (3); gaining or raising it costs XP.
aos-soulbound.rule.training.combines: Adds dice to a Skill Test alongside the character’s Attribute.
aos-soulbound.rule.training.blocked_reason: This is a standard test procedure.

aos-soulbound.rule.focus.name: Focus

effect.summary: Each Focus level adds +1 to a die result on a Skill Test, up to three levels.

aos-soulbound.rule.focus.cost_or_limit: Maximum Focus (3); gaining or raising it costs XP.
aos-soulbound.rule.focus.combines: Bonuses may be placed on separate dice or combined on one die.
aos-soulbound.rule.focus.blocked_reason: This is a standard test procedure.

aos-soulbound.rule.a-warm-meal.name: A Warm Meal

effect.summary: Cooking for companions during a Rest restores 1 Soulfire to the Binding.

aos-soulbound.rule.a-warm-meal.cost_or_limit: Requires cooking utensils and ingredients; used during a Rest.
aos-soulbound.rule.a-warm-meal.mind: A warm meal bolsters the spirit.
aos-soulbound.rule.a-warm-meal.who_may: A character with suitable tools and ingredients
aos-soulbound.rule.a-warm-meal.combines: Benefits the Binding and its companions.
aos-soulbound.rule.a-warm-meal.blocked_reason: The effect restores a game resource.

aos-soulbound.rule.talents-and-xp.name: Talents and XP

effect.summary: Talents are abilities characters may select or learn with XP; each costs 2 XP, and some can be taken multiple times.

aos-soulbound.rule.talents-and-xp.cost_or_limit: Each Talent costs 2 XP; requirements must usually be met.
aos-soulbound.rule.talents-and-xp.go_wrong: The GM may permit a Talent without its requirements.

aos-soulbound.rule.learning-additional-l.name: Learning additional Lores of Magic

effect.summary: Additional Lores require escalating Channelling or Mind thresholds and extra XP.

aos-soulbound.rule.learning-additional-l.cost_or_limit: Second through eighth Lore have the stated skill or Mind thresholds and additional XP costs.
aos-soulbound.rule.learning-additional-l.mind: Mind thresholds apply from the sixth Lore onward.
aos-soulbound.rule.learning-additional-l.blocked_reason: It is a progression restriction and cost.

aos-soulbound.rule.gifts-of-the-sylvanet.name: Gifts of the Sylvaneth

effect.summary: Sylvaneth may attack non-Sylvaneth seen wielding their kin’s woven weapons; identifying marks can avert mistaken hostility.

aos-soulbound.rule.gifts-of-the-sylvanet.who_may: Sylvaneth and outsiders bearing woven weapons.
aos-soulbound.rule.gifts-of-the-sylvanet.blocked_reason: It is a conditional reaction rule.

aos-soulbound.rule.availability-categori.name: Availability categories

effect.summary: none stated

aos-soulbound.rule.availability-categori.cost_or_limit: Items are classified Common, Rare, Exotic, or Special; access worsens with rarity and can vary by location.
aos-soulbound.rule.availability-categori.blocked_reason: This is a procurement rule, not a special effect.

aos-soulbound.rule.aether-rig-power-capa.name: Aether-rig power capacity

effect.summary: Installed devices cannot consume more power than their rig’s capacity.

aos-soulbound.rule.aether-rig-power-capa.cost_or_limit: Basic rigs have capacity 6; missed maintenance reduces capacity by 1 between adventures.
aos-soulbound.rule.aether-rig-power-capa.go_wrong: Devices may stop working when capacity is insufficient.
aos-soulbound.rule.aether-rig-power-capa.where_from: Aether-rig power ingots and power management
aos-soulbound.rule.aether-rig-power-capa.mechanism: Bound equipment power budget and depletion
aos-soulbound.rule.aether-rig-power-capa.blocked_reason: The rule requires a capacity limit, attached powers, and supply depletion.

aos-soulbound.rule.ur-gold-power-and-ris.name: Ur-gold power and risk

effect.summary: Ur-gold contains a fragment of Grimnir’s power; a wielder without sufficient will is consumed, burned to ash.

aos-soulbound.rule.ur-gold-power-and-ris.cost_or_limit: Requires exceptional will and determination to control.
aos-soulbound.rule.ur-gold-power-and-ris.go_wrong: A weak wielder is burned from within and reduced to ash.
aos-soulbound.rule.ur-gold-power-and-ris.where_from: Ur-gold is believed to be scattered gold containing Grimnir’s spirit.
aos-soulbound.rule.ur-gold-power-and-ris.combines: Power is held in the runes.
aos-soulbound.rule.ur-gold-power-and-ris.mechanism: Power source with a will-based control limit.
aos-soulbound.rule.ur-gold-power-and-ris.blocked_reason: The fatal outcome depends on a character’s will and needs a specific failure condition.

aos-soulbound.rule.active-ur-gold-rune-l.name: Active ur-gold rune limit

effect.summary: A character can have active ur-gold runes up to their Soul score.

aos-soulbound.rule.active-ur-gold-rune-l.cost_or_limit: Active rune count cannot exceed Soul.
aos-soulbound.rule.active-ur-gold-rune-l.combines: Repeated runes of the same type have cumulative effects.
aos-soulbound.rule.active-ur-gold-rune-l.blocked_reason: A numeric capacity limit can be represented directly.

aos-soulbound.rule.cumulative-matching-r.name: Cumulative matching runes

effect.summary: Multiple active runes of one type stack their effects.

aos-soulbound.rule.cumulative-matching-r.who_may: Characters with multiple runes of one type.
aos-soulbound.rule.cumulative-matching-r.blocked_reason: Stacking can be represented as repeated additions.

aos-soulbound.rule.rune-battle-activatio.name: Rune battle activation and duration

effect.summary: Runes awaken in battle at Initiative, offer no benefit while Surprised, and last one adventure before becoming inert.

aos-soulbound.rule.rune-battle-activatio.cost_or_limit: Typically active for one adventure, about three to five sessions.
aos-soulbound.rule.rune-battle-activatio.go_wrong: Runes become inert and their bonuses end after their duration or use.
aos-soulbound.rule.rune-battle-activatio.combines: Battle use releases Grimnir’s spirit; used runes lose their luster and become inert.
aos-soulbound.rule.rune-battle-activatio.mechanism: Triggered activation and duration with a depleted state.
aos-soulbound.rule.rune-battle-activatio.blocked_reason: The rule requires tracking activation, use, and an inert item state.

aos-soulbound.rule.grimnir-s-release-fro.name: Grimnir’s release from used runes

effect.summary: Battle use releases the spirit held in an ur-gold rune, leaving it inert.

aos-soulbound.rule.grimnir-s-release-fro.cost_or_limit: A used rune loses its power.
aos-soulbound.rule.grimnir-s-release-fro.where_from: The Fyreslayers’ belief about Grimnir and ur-gold.
aos-soulbound.rule.grimnir-s-release-fro.combines: Related to rune activation and depletion.
aos-soulbound.rule.grimnir-s-release-fro.blocked_reason: The effect directly changes the state of a god’s spirit.

aos-soulbound.rule.kharadron-code-artycl.name: Kharadron Code, Artycle 6

effect.summary: Kharadron captains disclaim responsibility for passenger injury, lost limbs, or undue death under Artycle 6.

aos-soulbound.rule.kharadron-code-artycl.cost_or_limit: Applies to travel with Kharadron captains.
aos-soulbound.rule.kharadron-code-artycl.go_wrong: Passengers are expected to defend themselves during attacks.
aos-soulbound.rule.kharadron-code-artycl.blocked_reason: A legal restriction can be represented as a rule.

aos-soulbound.rule.tests.name: Tests

effect.summary: Uncertain or opposed actions are resolved by rolling a dice pool against a Difficulty and Complexity.

aos-soulbound.rule.tests.cost_or_limit: Dice pool equals Attribute plus Skill Training; successes must meet Complexity.
aos-soulbound.rule.tests.go_wrong: Failure occurs when successes are absent or below Complexity.
aos-soulbound.rule.tests.combines: Common, opposed, and extended tests are described.
aos-soulbound.rule.tests.blocked_reason: Game procedure is excluded from the ledger’s world-mechanism rule category.

aos-soulbound.rule.mettle-maximum-and-re.name: Mettle maximum and recovery

effect.summary: Maximum Mettle is half Soul rounded up, and one point returns at the start of each turn.

aos-soulbound.rule.mettle-maximum-and-re.cost_or_limit: Maximum may be changed by spells or Talents.
aos-soulbound.rule.mettle-maximum-and-re.mind: Mettle represents inner drive and strength of spirit.
aos-soulbound.rule.mettle-maximum-and-re.combines: Used for extra actions and to power Miracles and some Talents.
aos-soulbound.rule.mettle-maximum-and-re.blocked_reason: This is game procedure rather than a world-mechanism rule.

aos-soulbound.rule.soulfire-and-the-bind.name: Soulfire and the Binding’s consent

effect.summary: Soulfire draws on the entwined spirits of the Binding; using it without consent draws on unwilling allies’ strength.

aos-soulbound.rule.soulfire-and-the-bind.cost_or_limit: Only Binding members can use Soulfire.
aos-soulbound.rule.soulfire-and-the-bind.go_wrong: Using Soulfire without agreement increases Doom by one.
aos-soulbound.rule.soulfire-and-the-bind.who_may: Binding members use it; non-members cannot.
aos-soulbound.rule.soulfire-and-the-bind.where_from: The souls of the Binding are entwined.
aos-soulbound.rule.soulfire-and-the-bind.combines: Consent is required unless the user overrides the Binding’s refusal.
aos-soulbound.rule.soulfire-and-the-bind.blocked_reason: The bond and consent restriction can be represented as a rule.

aos-soulbound.rule.last-stand.name: Last Stand

effect.summary: A Mortally Wounded hero may sacrifice themselves before a Death Test, gaining combat benefits until dying at turn’s end and refilling the Binding’s Soulfire.

aos-soulbound.rule.last-stand.cost_or_limit: Must be Mortally Wounded; ends in death
aos-soulbound.rule.last-stand.go_wrong: The character dies when their turn ends
aos-soulbound.rule.last-stand.blocked_reason: The rule links death and a character’s spirit to the Binding’s resource.

aos-soulbound.rule.ur-gold-rune-forging.name: Ur-gold rune forging

effect.summary: A Zharrgrim can forge one rune per 3 pounds of suitable ur-gold by completing an extended test.

aos-soulbound.rule.ur-gold-rune-forging.cost_or_limit: Requires a forge, smith’s tools, and lustrous ur-gold imbued with Grimnir’s essence; the test is DN 4:8 with three tests in a week
aos-soulbound.rule.ur-gold-rune-forging.who_may: A Zharrgrim with the required tools and materials
aos-soulbound.rule.ur-gold-rune-forging.combines: The first two tests use Body (Crafting); the final test uses Soul (Devotion)
aos-soulbound.rule.ur-gold-rune-forging.blocked_reason: The rule is a crafting procedure and has no missing basic effect capability.

aos-soulbound.rule.ur-gold-is-retained-a.name: Ur-gold is retained after a failed forging

effect.summary: Ur-gold spent on an unsuccessful forging attempt is not lost and may be reused.

aos-soulbound.rule.ur-gold-is-retained-a.go_wrong: A failed attempt produces no successful forging.
aos-soulbound.rule.ur-gold-is-retained-a.blocked_reason: The rule concerns a simple resource limit and can run with the basic effect grammar.

aos-soulbound.rule.grundtogg-replenishes.name: Grundtogg replenishes or replaces inert ur-gold runes

effect.summary: A Runesmiter hammers selected runes into a Fyreslayer’s flesh, granting their benefits for the next adventure.

aos-soulbound.rule.grundtogg-replenishes.cost_or_limit: Requires a Runesmiter; the number of runes is limited by Soul.
aos-soulbound.rule.grundtogg-replenishes.where_from: A Runesmiter, often at a Fyreslayer Lodge
aos-soulbound.rule.grundtogg-replenishes.combines: Uses ur-gold runes listed on page 117.
aos-soulbound.rule.grundtogg-replenishes.blocked_reason: The runes are installed in a body and grant benefits, but the passage gives no basic-grammar mechanism for powers carried by installed items.

aos-soulbound.rule.a-weapon-can-receive-.name: A weapon can receive Magical Weapon Weave once

effect.summary: A weapon created using Weapon Weave can be enhanced with Ghyran’s life magic and one selected Trait.

aos-soulbound.rule.a-weapon-can-receive-.cost_or_limit: The weapon can be enhanced only once; the endeavour allows three Tests over a week.
aos-soulbound.rule.a-weapon-can-receive-.go_wrong: On failure, the weapon remains unchanged.
aos-soulbound.rule.a-weapon-can-receive-.who_may: A character with Weapon Weave Talent
aos-soulbound.rule.a-weapon-can-receive-.where_from: A magical loom and Ghyran’s life magic
aos-soulbound.rule.a-weapon-can-receive-.combines: Adds the Magical Trait and one selected Trait: Penetrating, Reach, Restraining, or Rend.
aos-soulbound.rule.a-weapon-can-receive-.blocked_reason: The passage changes a weapon’s lasting traits, which the basic effect grammar does not model as item state.

aos-soulbound.rule.aether-rigs-lose-powe.name: Aether-rigs lose Power Capacity without maintenance

effect.summary: An Aether-rig loses one Power Capacity at the start of the next adventure if its owner skips maintenance.

aos-soulbound.rule.aether-rigs-lose-powe.cost_or_limit: Regular Maintenance replenishes diminished aetheric power ingots.
aos-soulbound.rule.aether-rigs-lose-powe.go_wrong: Some equipment may stop functioning as capacity falls.
aos-soulbound.rule.aether-rigs-lose-powe.combines: Power Capacity can affect whether equipment functions.
aos-soulbound.rule.aether-rigs-lose-powe.blocked_reason: This rule tracks equipment capacity and function, which are not represented by the basic effect grammar.

aos-soulbound.rule.a-new-endeavour-takes.name: A new Endeavour takes a week in one location

effect.summary: A newly designed Endeavour should be completable in a week at one location; an Extended Test should use no more than three Tests.

aos-soulbound.rule.a-new-endeavour-takes.cost_or_limit: Three Tests maximum for an Extended Test; any combination of Attributes and Skills may be used.
aos-soulbound.rule.a-new-endeavour-takes.combines: Extended Tests may combine any Attributes and Skills.
aos-soulbound.rule.a-new-endeavour-takes.blocked_reason: This is a game-procedure limit rather than a world mechanism.

aos-soulbound.rule.realmgates-connect-di.name: Realmgates connect distant places

effect.summary: Dimensional pathways connect locations within a realm and between realms, sometimes across the aetheric void.

aos-soulbound.rule.realmgates-connect-di.cost_or_limit: Their number, pattern, and destinations are largely unknown; some are sealed, destroyed, or corrupted.
aos-soulbound.rule.realmgates-connect-di.go_wrong: Corrupted gates may open into the Realm of Chaos; travel can be treacherous.
aos-soulbound.rule.realmgates-connect-di.who_may: Travellers who can access a gate
aos-soulbound.rule.realmgates-connect-di.where_from: The network of realmgates across the realms
aos-soulbound.rule.realmgates-connect-di.combines: Can link far-separated locations and realms.
aos-soulbound.rule.realmgates-connect-di.blocked_reason: The stated mechanism is movement between locations.

aos-soulbound.rule.chamon-s-shifting-lan.name: Chamon’s shifting lands

effect.summary: Its sub-realms drift and change, sometimes merging or breaking apart.

aos-soulbound.rule.chamon-s-shifting-lan.combines: Portals and mystical bonds connect the sub-realms.

aos-soulbound.rule.ghur-s-predatory-land.name: Ghur’s predatory lands

effect.summary: Landmasses hunt, shift, and consume neighboring lands.

aos-soulbound.rule.ghur-s-predatory-land.go_wrong: Chasms and duelling mountains threaten travellers.

aos-soulbound.rule.ghyran-s-corporeal-un.name: Ghyran’s corporeal undead

effect.summary: Corporeal undead quickly decay into the living realm's cycles.

aos-soulbound.rule.ghyran-s-corporeal-un.cost_or_limit: Applies to corporeal undead in Ghyran.
aos-soulbound.rule.ghyran-s-corporeal-un.blocked_reason: The setting rule governs the fate of undead bodies and spirits.

aos-soulbound.rule.aetherquartz-absorpti.name: Aetherquartz absorption

effect.summary: Lumineth gain speed of thought and action while shedding lesser emotions.

aos-soulbound.rule.aetherquartz-absorpti.cost_or_limit: The emotional purge accompanies the enhancement.
aos-soulbound.rule.aetherquartz-absorpti.blocked_reason: It alters emotion and cognition beyond the basic effect grammar.

aos-soulbound.rule.shyish-s-underworlds.name: Shyish’s underworlds

effect.summary: Belief and cultural practice can cause new underworlds and gods to form.

aos-soulbound.rule.shyish-s-underworlds.cost_or_limit: Even small deviations in belief can trigger new formation.
aos-soulbound.rule.shyish-s-underworlds.go_wrong: Misunderstanding of ancient practices can create a new land.
aos-soulbound.rule.shyish-s-underworlds.combines: New underworlds arise at the realm's edge.
aos-soulbound.rule.shyish-s-underworlds.blocked_reason: The rule creates lands populated by spirits based on belief.

aos-soulbound.rule.necroquake-s-spiritua.name: Necroquake's spiritual reversal

effect.summary: Shyish's spiritual energies reversed direction, pulling inward toward the Nadir.

aos-soulbound.rule.necroquake-s-spiritua.go_wrong: Underworlds and spirits are drawn toward destruction.
aos-soulbound.rule.necroquake-s-spiritua.combines: The Nadir grows in strength as it draws things inward.
aos-soulbound.rule.necroquake-s-spiritua.blocked_reason: The mechanism governs the movement and fate of spirits and underworlds.

aos-soulbound.rule.ulgu-and-hysh-share-a.name: Ulgu and Hysh share a parallel orbit

effect.summary: The paired realms have neither night nor day.

aos-soulbound.rule.ulgu-and-hysh-share-a.cost_or_limit: Neither realm has a normal day-night cycle.
aos-soulbound.rule.ulgu-and-hysh-share-a.blocked_reason: This is a setting rule, not an effect beyond the basic grammar.

aos-soulbound.rule.ulgu-s-true-name-resi.name: Ulgu’s true name resists pronunciation

effect.summary: The realm’s true name cannot normally be pronounced; shadow and whispering may permit it, though that is uncertain.

aos-soulbound.rule.ulgu-s-true-name-resi.cost_or_limit: Speaking it requires shadow and a whisper, according to the account.
aos-soulbound.rule.ulgu-s-true-name-resi.combines: The exception is described as suspect.
aos-soulbound.rule.ulgu-s-true-name-resi.blocked_reason: The restriction can be represented as a basic blocking effect.

aos-soulbound.rule.the-eightpoints-porta.name: The Eightpoints’ portals no longer connect to every Mortal Realm

effect.summary: Access through several Arcway portals is unavailable or controlled.

aos-soulbound.rule.the-eightpoints-porta.cost_or_limit: Azyr’s road remains closed; Aqshy’s and Ghyran’s gates were sealed; the Ghur gate is outside Archaon’s control.
aos-soulbound.rule.the-eightpoints-porta.combines: The Ghurish gate is held in Fangathrak’s maw.
aos-soulbound.rule.the-eightpoints-porta.blocked_reason: This is a direct restriction on movement.

aos-soulbound.rule.a-cauldron-of-blood-n.name: A Cauldron of Blood never overflows

effect.summary: Blood beyond the cauldron’s apparent capacity is diverted elsewhere.

aos-soulbound.rule.a-cauldron-of-blood-n.cost_or_limit: The cauldron cannot overflow regardless of how much blood is spilled.
aos-soulbound.rule.a-cauldron-of-blood-n.go_wrong: The destination of the surplus is disputed.
aos-soulbound.rule.a-cauldron-of-blood-n.combines: The surplus supposedly nourishes Khaine or Morathi.
aos-soulbound.rule.a-cauldron-of-blood-n.blocked_reason: The rule requires a special capacity and overflow-diversion mechanic.

aos-soulbound.rule.fyreslayer-oath-keepi.name: Fyreslayer oath-keeping

effect.summary: Once sworn, a Fyreslayer contract remains binding despite consequences.

aos-soulbound.rule.fyreslayer-oath-keepi.cost_or_limit: Clients are expected to honour the same oath and pay debts.
aos-soulbound.rule.fyreslayer-oath-keepi.go_wrong: A broken oath or unpaid debt provokes Fyreslayer wrath.
aos-soulbound.rule.fyreslayer-oath-keepi.blocked_reason: The relationship constraint is representable as a basic binding effect.

aos-soulbound.rule.idoneth-soul-transfer.name: Idoneth soul transfer

effect.summary: Idoneth sorcery removes spirit essence from one being and transplants it into an infant.

aos-soulbound.rule.idoneth-soul-transfer.cost_or_limit: Used to sustain their young because viable natural births are rare.
aos-soulbound.rule.idoneth-soul-transfer.go_wrong: The transferred infants are left blind and branded for life.
aos-soulbound.rule.idoneth-soul-transfer.mind: The recipient is affected by the soul transfer; no other mental effect is stated.
aos-soulbound.rule.idoneth-soul-transfer.combines: Performed as an infant ritual to give a soul to offspring.
aos-soulbound.rule.idoneth-soul-transfer.blocked_reason: Moving a soul between beings requires explicit soul-state and transfer mechanics.

aos-soulbound.rule.idoneth-soul-scarcity.name: Idoneth soul scarcity

effect.summary: Only a small minority of Idoneth are naturally born with souls that survive infancy.

aos-soulbound.rule.idoneth-soul-scarcity.cost_or_limit: About one in a hundred survive in this way.
aos-soulbound.rule.idoneth-soul-scarcity.go_wrong: Most offspring need transplanted spirit essence.
aos-soulbound.rule.idoneth-soul-scarcity.combines: Drives their raids and soul transference.
aos-soulbound.rule.idoneth-soul-scarcity.blocked_reason: The rule depends on tracking soul presence and survival.

aos-soulbound.rule.aether-gold-keeps-kha.name: Aether-gold keeps Kharadron skyships aloft

effect.summary: A skyship cannot stay airborne without aether-gold.

aos-soulbound.rule.aether-gold-keeps-kha.cost_or_limit: The fuel is required for continued flight; sky-ports also depend on it.
aos-soulbound.rule.aether-gold-keeps-kha.go_wrong: Without it, ships and sky-ports crash.
aos-soulbound.rule.aether-gold-keeps-kha.blocked_reason: The dependency can be represented as a basic blocking effect.

aos-soulbound.rule.stormcast-return-and-.name: Stormcast return and reforging

effect.summary: A killing blow sends a Stormcast to Azyr for arduous, imperfect reforging.

aos-soulbound.rule.stormcast-return-and-.cost_or_limit: Only the most extreme circumstances allow death’s peace.
aos-soulbound.rule.stormcast-return-and-.go_wrong: Repeated reforging alters mind and body.
aos-soulbound.rule.stormcast-return-and-.mind: Reforging changes the returned warrior’s mind.
aos-soulbound.rule.stormcast-return-and-.where_from: A killing blow triggers return to Azyr.
aos-soulbound.rule.stormcast-return-and-.combines: The process repeats across successive deaths.
aos-soulbound.rule.stormcast-return-and-.blocked_reason: The rule requires death, soul return, and persistent changes across lives.

aos-soulbound.rule.spirit-song.name: Spirit Song

effect.summary: A shared song connects Sylvaneth and carries communication over great distances.

aos-soulbound.rule.spirit-song.cost_or_limit: It grows stronger among gathered Sylvaneth; outsiders cannot truly understand it.
aos-soulbound.rule.spirit-song.go_wrong: Non-Sylvaneth listeners may suffer intense pain or madness.
aos-soulbound.rule.spirit-song.mind: Can distress or drive non-Sylvaneth listeners mad.
aos-soulbound.rule.spirit-song.who_may: Sylvaneth share and understand it; others may hear it.
aos-soulbound.rule.spirit-song.where_from: Its source is Alarielle in Ghyran.
aos-soulbound.rule.spirit-song.combines: In distress, it becomes the Song of War and rouses Sylvaneth to battle.
aos-soulbound.rule.spirit-song.blocked_reason: It works across distances and can affect groups’ minds.

aos-soulbound.rule.aqshy-s-shifting-day-.name: Aqshy’s shifting day length

effect.summary: Days last roughly 26–30 hours depending on the Dance of the Spheres.

aos-soulbound.rule.aqshy-s-shifting-day-.cost_or_limit: Duration varies by location and celestial cycles.
aos-soulbound.rule.aqshy-s-shifting-day-.combines: The Azyrheim calendar accounts for this fluctuation.
aos-soulbound.rule.aqshy-s-shifting-day-.blocked_reason: The rule makes the length of a day vary with place and celestial cycles.

aos-soulbound.rule.potable-water-scarcit.name: Potable water scarcity

effect.summary: Central Great Parch water is scarce, while surrounding seas are generally unsafe to drink.

aos-soulbound.rule.potable-water-scarcit.cost_or_limit: Settlements conserve, store, or import water.
aos-soulbound.rule.potable-water-scarcit.go_wrong: Rain may be sulphurous and ruin crops or water sources.
aos-soulbound.rule.potable-water-scarcit.who_may: Most species cannot drink the seas.
aos-soulbound.rule.potable-water-scarcit.combines: Cisterns, wells, and trade help communities survive.

effect.summary: Order forces retook much of the plateau and seized assets.

aos-soulbound.rule.miracles-can-feed-fai.name: Miracles can feed faith

effect.summary: A miracle can inspire faith that may give the deity more power than the miracle cost.

aos-soulbound.rule.miracles-can-feed-fai.cost_or_limit: The power gain is only potential.
aos-soulbound.rule.miracles-can-feed-fai.blocked_reason: The feedback loop requires transferring power between a god, a miracle, and believers.

aos-soulbound.rule.divine-power-requires.name: Divine power requires presence

effect.summary: A deity cannot influence a realm or extend power into it without a presence there, usually through worshippers.

aos-soulbound.rule.divine-power-requires.cost_or_limit: A presence in the realm is required.
aos-soulbound.rule.divine-power-requires.combines: Devout worshippers provide a usual presence.
aos-soulbound.rule.divine-power-requires.blocked_reason: The restriction depends on a deity’s presence and worshippers as a condition for power.

aos-soulbound.rule.gods-are-not-omniscie.name: Gods are not omniscient

effect.summary: Even gods can see farther than mortals but are not all-knowing and may ignore mortal concerns.

aos-soulbound.rule.gods-are-not-omniscie.cost_or_limit: Deities are not omniscient and have competing demands.
aos-soulbound.rule.gods-are-not-omniscie.blocked_reason: Representing partial, realm-spanning divine knowledge needs a divination and information-access system.

aos-soulbound.rule.gods-rely-on-worship.name: Gods rely on worship

effect.summary: Belief by mortals empowers the gods and supports their influence.

aos-soulbound.rule.gods-rely-on-worship.cost_or_limit: Influence depends on mortal belief and a presence in the realm.
aos-soulbound.rule.gods-rely-on-worship.go_wrong: Faith can shift toward hatred when gods are absent.
aos-soulbound.rule.gods-rely-on-worship.blocked_reason: The rule converts mortal belief into divine power, a transfer not represented by the basic effect grammar.

aos-soulbound.rule.sigmarite-strictures.name: Sigmarite Strictures

effect.summary: Followers must oppose Chaos, spread faith, treat other gods’ servants fairly, and uphold civilization and progress.

aos-soulbound.rule.sigmarite-strictures.cost_or_limit: The tenets apply to Sigmar’s faithful.

aos-soulbound.rule.necroquake.name: Necroquake

effect.summary: A flawed spell released a vast wave of death energy, causing dead legions to rise.

aos-soulbound.rule.necroquake.cost_or_limit: Nagash’s plan was disrupted by flaws and Skaven interference.
aos-soulbound.rule.necroquake.go_wrong: The reversed energies overwhelmed Nagash and burst outward across the cosmos.
aos-soulbound.rule.necroquake.where_from: Shyish Nadir and the Black Pyramid
aos-soulbound.rule.necroquake.blocked_reason: Raising the dead and manipulating souls require a soul-state and resurrection mechanism.

effect.summary: Followers must be united in Nagash, pay him his due, administer proportionate harsh justice, and praise no other god before him.

aos-soulbound.rule.respect-the-natural-o.name: Respect the natural order.

effect.summary: Alarielle’s followers are expected to respect nature’s order.

aos-soulbound.rule.respect-the-natural-o.blocked_reason: This is a roleplaying constraint, not a supernatural effect.

aos-soulbound.rule.take-only-what-is-nee.name: Take only what is needed from the land.

effect.summary: Followers should not take more land resources than necessary.

aos-soulbound.rule.honour-whatever-must-.name: Honour whatever must be taken, for it is a sacrifice made for your benefit.

effect.summary: Followers should honour resources taken from the land.

aos-soulbound.rule.oppose-the-taint-of-c.name: Oppose the taint of Chaos in all its forms.

effect.summary: Alarielle’s followers must resist Chaos.

aos-soulbound.rule.oppose-the-taint-of-c.cost_or_limit: Applies to all forms of Chaos.

aos-soulbound.rule.with-each-use-the-ur-.name: With each use, the ur-gold diminishes.

effect.summary: Using ur-gold to channel Grimnir consumes some of it.

aos-soulbound.rule.with-each-use-the-ur-.cost_or_limit: Each use reduces the available ur-gold.
aos-soulbound.rule.with-each-use-the-ur-.blocked_reason: It specifies depletion of a material that carries a power.

aos-soulbound.rule.nurgle-s-over-indulge.name: Nurgle’s over-indulgence

effect.summary: none

aos-soulbound.rule.nurgle-s-over-indulge.cost_or_limit: Accumulated divine diseases increase a follower’s might.
aos-soulbound.rule.nurgle-s-over-indulge.go_wrong: Over-gifting can dissolve a follower or create a mindless plague spawn.
aos-soulbound.rule.nurgle-s-over-indulge.mind: A plague spawn may be mindless.
aos-soulbound.rule.nurgle-s-over-indulge.blocked_reason: The outcome can radically change a follower’s form and mental state.

aos-soulbound.rule.tzeentch-s-unpredicta.name: Tzeentch’s unpredictable tenets

effect.summary: none

aos-soulbound.rule.tzeentch-s-unpredicta.cost_or_limit: There are no universal follower rules except treating change as sacred.
aos-soulbound.rule.tzeentch-s-unpredicta.go_wrong: Tenets may differ between cults and sorcerers.
aos-soulbound.rule.tzeentch-s-unpredicta.blocked_reason: This describes variable beliefs, not a game mechanism requiring unsupported effects.

aos-soulbound.rule.magic-as-a-building-b.name: Magic as a building block of the realms

effect.summary: none

aos-soulbound.rule.magic-as-a-building-b.cost_or_limit: The passage presents this as one cultural belief about magic’s origin.
aos-soulbound.rule.magic-as-a-building-b.blocked_reason: This is a setting explanation rather than an actionable effect.

aos-soulbound.rule.lore-and-realm-affini.name: Lore and realm affinity

effect.summary: none

aos-soulbound.rule.lore-and-realm-affini.cost_or_limit: Each realm has an affinity for a lore, and that magic is easiest to cast there; other lores also occur in every realm.
aos-soulbound.rule.lore-and-realm-affini.go_wrong: Uncontrolled power may devastate the caster and nearby beings or create an Endless Spell.
aos-soulbound.rule.lore-and-realm-affini.who_may: Wizards with an affinity for the realm’s magic
aos-soulbound.rule.lore-and-realm-affini.blocked_reason: The passage also describes uncontrolled magical energy affecting a caster and those around them.

aos-soulbound.rule.the-curse-of-realmsto.name: The curse of realmstone

effect.summary: none

aos-soulbound.rule.the-curse-of-realmsto.cost_or_limit: Realmstone is valuable and useful but dangerous to traffic in or use regularly.
aos-soulbound.rule.the-curse-of-realmsto.go_wrong: Misfortune, calamity, derangement, and mutation may afflict users.
aos-soulbound.rule.the-curse-of-realmsto.who_may: Those who traffic in or regularly use realmstone
aos-soulbound.rule.the-curse-of-realmsto.blocked_reason: The passage gives no specific probability or control for the accumulating harmful effects.

aos-soulbound.rule.realmstone-formation.name: Realmstone formation

effect.summary: none

aos-soulbound.rule.realmstone-formation.cost_or_limit: It forms at realm edges, over time near ley lines or power pools, or after powerful magical events.
aos-soulbound.rule.realmstone-formation.go_wrong: The realm edge is likely fatal for a mortal to reach.
aos-soulbound.rule.realmstone-formation.combines: Its properties vary with the magical energy that formed it.
aos-soulbound.rule.realmstone-formation.blocked_reason: The passage describes matter forming from magical energy without rules for its creation.

aos-soulbound.rule.realmstone-value-and-.name: Realmstone value and use

effect.summary: none

aos-soulbound.rule.realmstone-value-and-.cost_or_limit: Even small pieces can enable arcane feats; larger quantities underpin artefacts and trade between realms.
aos-soulbound.rule.realmstone-value-and-.go_wrong: Use remains hazardous under realmstone’s curse.
aos-soulbound.rule.realmstone-value-and-.blocked_reason: The passage does not state how much power an artefact can hold or expend.

aos-soulbound.rule.endless-spell-persist.name: Endless Spell persistence

effect.summary: none

aos-soulbound.rule.endless-spell-persist.cost_or_limit: A spell can persist instead of fading after its effect.
aos-soulbound.rule.endless-spell-persist.go_wrong: Endless Spells may turn on their casters, grow stronger over time, and cause deaths if uncontrolled.
aos-soulbound.rule.endless-spell-persist.who_may: Arcane wielders can create them as conduits for realm energies.
aos-soulbound.rule.endless-spell-persist.combines: Often strongly connected to a realm’s magic; some are polluted by Necroquake energy.
aos-soulbound.rule.endless-spell-persist.blocked_reason: The spells may act independently, turn on their creator, or grow stronger over time.

aos-soulbound.rule.multiple-spell-effect.name: Multiple spell effects

effect.summary: none

aos-soulbound.rule.multiple-spell-effect.cost_or_limit: Different spells can affect a creature simultaneously.
aos-soulbound.rule.multiple-spell-effect.go_wrong: Repeated castings of the same spell do not stack; only the stronger or longer-lasting effect applies.
aos-soulbound.rule.multiple-spell-effect.combines: Different spells coexist; duplicates use the better effect.
aos-soulbound.rule.multiple-spell-effect.blocked_reason: This rule can be represented as a limit on combining effects.

aos-soulbound.rule.shared-spellcasting.name: Shared spellcasting

effect.summary: none

aos-soulbound.rule.shared-spellcasting.cost_or_limit: An assistant must have Spellcasting Talent and be in the same Zone; Help adds dice based on Training, with a further bonus for sharing a lore.
aos-soulbound.rule.shared-spellcasting.go_wrong: If the spell fails, both casters suffer the effects.
aos-soulbound.rule.shared-spellcasting.who_may: A spellcaster and a qualifying assistant
aos-soulbound.rule.shared-spellcasting.combines: Assistance increases the caster’s dice pool.
aos-soulbound.rule.shared-spellcasting.blocked_reason: The rule combines multiple casters’ contributions and shares failure consequences.

aos-soulbound.rule.casting-a-spell.name: Casting a spell

effect.summary: none

aos-soulbound.rule.casting-a-spell.cost_or_limit: Casting uses an Action and a Mind (Channelling) Test against the spell’s DN.
aos-soulbound.rule.casting-a-spell.go_wrong: A failed or overpowered spell can have deadly consequences.
aos-soulbound.rule.casting-a-spell.combines: Extra successes can Overcast, often increasing damage or duration.
aos-soulbound.rule.casting-a-spell.blocked_reason: This is a game procedure rather than a world mechanism.

aos-soulbound.rule.channelling-failure-d.name: Channelling failure dice

effect.summary: A failed Channelling Test rolls dice equal to spell complexity minus successes.

aos-soulbound.rule.channelling-failure-d.cost_or_limit: The number of dice is the complexity difference, counting zero successes as zero.
aos-soulbound.rule.channelling-failure-d.blocked_reason: The rule is a direct roll-based cost.

aos-soulbound.rule.failed-spell-conseque.name: Failed spell consequences

effect.summary: Failure costs can cause damage, reverse the spell, stun or incapacitate the caster, or summon an Endless Spell.

aos-soulbound.rule.failed-spell-conseque.cost_or_limit: The result depends on the cost-table roll.
aos-soulbound.rule.failed-spell-conseque.go_wrong: The caster may suffer escalating harm, incapacitation, unconsciousness, or magical backlash.
aos-soulbound.rule.failed-spell-conseque.who_may: Spellcasters who fail a Channelling Test
aos-soulbound.rule.failed-spell-conseque.combines: The highest result summons an Endless Spell in the caster’s Zone.
aos-soulbound.rule.failed-spell-conseque.blocked_reason: The table includes an unspecified reversed spell and GM-selected summoned spell.

aos-soulbound.rule.spell-aspects-determi.name: Spell Aspects determine spell effects and cost

effect.summary: Spell Aspects describe a spell’s effect and contribute to its Difficulty and Complexity.

aos-soulbound.rule.spell-aspects-determi.cost_or_limit: Major Aspects define healing, harm, help, or hindrance; Minor Aspects define targets, range, and duration.
aos-soulbound.rule.spell-aspects-determi.combines: Aspect costs are added to calculate the casting DN.
aos-soulbound.rule.spell-aspects-determi.blocked_reason: This is a spell-design rule rather than an unrepresentable in-world effect.

aos-soulbound.rule.major-aspect-costs.name: Major Aspect costs

effect.summary: Listed costs assign values to healing, harm, enhancement, and hindrance effects.

aos-soulbound.rule.major-aspect-costs.cost_or_limit: Examples include damage per point, Toughness recovery per point, and fixed costs for Conditions and bonuses.
aos-soulbound.rule.major-aspect-costs.combines: These costs contribute to the spell’s total Aspect cost.
aos-soulbound.rule.major-aspect-costs.blocked_reason: This sets a design cost and is not itself a game-world effect.

aos-soulbound.rule.target-range-and-dura.name: Target, Range, and Duration costs

effect.summary: Spell reach, target count, area, and duration add costs to a spell.

aos-soulbound.rule.target-range-and-dura.cost_or_limit: Affects-caster costs 1; each target costs 1; a Zone costs 3; range and duration have listed costs.
aos-soulbound.rule.target-range-and-dura.combines: Longer range, additional targets, and duration raise total Aspect cost.
aos-soulbound.rule.target-range-and-dura.blocked_reason: This is a construction rule for spell costs.

aos-soulbound.rule.resisting-spell-effec.name: Resisting spell effects

effect.summary: A spell may allow targets an Opposed Test to resist some or all of its Aspects.

aos-soulbound.rule.resisting-spell-effec.cost_or_limit: The cost of a resistible Aspect is halved; resistance uses DN 4:S, with S based on successes.
aos-soulbound.rule.resisting-spell-effec.who_may: Spell designers, GM, and affected targets
aos-soulbound.rule.resisting-spell-effec.combines: Typical resistance tests use Body, Mind, or Soul.
aos-soulbound.rule.resisting-spell-effec.blocked_reason: This defines how spell effects may be resisted and priced.

aos-soulbound.rule.channelling-difficult.name: Channelling Difficulty and Complexity

effect.summary: Adding Aspect costs determines the spell’s casting Difficulty and Complexity.

aos-soulbound.rule.channelling-difficult.cost_or_limit: Total cost six or less gives Complexity 1; above six, Difficulty plus Complexity must equal the total cost.
aos-soulbound.rule.channelling-difficult.combines: The designer chooses the split when total cost exceeds six.
aos-soulbound.rule.channelling-difficult.blocked_reason: This is a rule for calculating a spell’s casting test.

aos-soulbound.rule.overcast-effects.name: Overcast effects

effect.summary: Additional successes can improve a spell through designated Overcast effects.

aos-soulbound.rule.overcast-effects.cost_or_limit: Successes required for an Overcast effect should equal its Aspect cost; spells generally have no more than two such effects.
aos-soulbound.rule.overcast-effects.combines: Possible improvements include damage, healing, duration, targets, area, or bonuses.
aos-soulbound.rule.overcast-effects.blocked_reason: This specifies how extra casting successes modify spells.
